warnings: Static deployed ABI/source inventory only; not fresh RPC/storage/bytecode identity, liquidity, backing, financial-safety or successful-execution assurance. Exact grants, canonical calldata, balance/allowance, protocol access restrictions, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory. All selected functions are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Underlying is 6-decimal Ethereum USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48; vault shares also 6 decimals (underlying cached at initialization, zero offset). deposit/mint require USDC allowance to the vault; withdraw/redeem and in-kind exits require owner share balance and share allowance when caller is not owner. Outputs go to explicit receiver/recipient.

deposit/mint enforce capacity and whenNotPaused. withdraw/redeem are intentionally not whenNotPaused in the reviewed implementation. Transient transaction action lock prevents mixing deposit/mint with withdraw/redeem in one transaction; same-action repetition is not that prohibition. No depositor role/KYC check is present in these bodies; underlying restrictions, frontend terms and legal eligibility remain independent.

No async request/claim queue exists in this V2 ABI. Legacy supply/withdraw queue getters unconditionally revert. withdrawFts is an in-kind exit, NOT a USDC cash claim: amount is the requested market FT face amount and is converted to burned vault shares with previewWithdraw rounding up. The fixed manager requires a registered nonzero order maturity mapping, obtains market FT through that order, and asks the order to transfer FT. No arbitrary target/payload or raw selector is accepted. FT maturity, order holdings and later redemption are independent; no FT trading/redemption capability is granted.

dealBadDebt burns owner shares priced by previewWithdraw(badDebtAmt) to receive pro-rata collateral from recorded vault bad debt, not USDC or guaranteed par value. collateral cannot equal asset; manager requires positive mapped bad debt and amount<=bad debt and computes floor(amount*collateralBalance/badDebt). No minimum collateral output or deadline exists, so small amounts can round to zero; token behavior, bad-debt accounting and recoverability remain risks.

Interest accrues linearly across order maturities, net of mutable curator performanceFeeRate, into accreting principal; totalAssets is that preview principal, not cash. Rate bounded by source constants; fees tracked separately and curator withdrawal excluded. Official current API reports performanceFeeRate=0 and timelock=86400 for this vault, not a live-storage guarantee. Idle base pool carries its own fees; official depositor guide describes an additional currently 2% protocol fee on passive idle yield, not principal. No fixed whole-vault all-in fee guarantee is made.

ERC4626 uses virtual +1 assets/+1 shares: deposit/redeem floor, mint/withdraw ceil. No caller slippage limits or deadline. Owner/curator can change markets, pool, capacity and fee configuration subject to asymmetric timelocks; guardian may pause. Clone targets fixed TermMaxVaultV2 implementation 0x9f1882FfBb007DD275C931ac302CfA97A4cEaa1D, which delegates only internally encoded operations to immutable OrderManagerV2 0xaec65f8f45b93e2de4cde40cbef9cac8e3345b41.
